Capital

Today in the UAE, Capital is predominantly payments — the infrastructure that opens new revenue streams and protects your business from no-shows.

Occupancy rate Client retention Booking frequency Average check Bookings value Online booking % Cancellations & no-shows

Benchmarks are built from real, anonymised partner data across the UAE — like this map of Dubai partners by business type.

What's a heat map?

Each dot is a real, anonymised partner salon — coloured by business type and clustered by neighbourhood. Denser clusters show where competition and client demand are highest, helping you see occupancy, pricing and booking patterns relative to salons around you. We're building this view out for this market now — your Growth Consultant can walk you through the closest available benchmark data today.
